name: certify_matmul_decomposition
description: Exactly certify or refute a claimed rank-R decomposition of the <n,m,p> matrix-multiplication tensor. Returns CERTIFIED with a certificate (all (nm)(mp)(np) tensor equations verified in exact rational arithmetic — no floats participate in any decision), REFUTED with the mechanism (the first violated equation, the exact left side, required right side, and exact discrepancy — or the rank overflow), or REFUSED with the reason when the claim is not well-formed enough to decide. Entries must be integers or exact rational strings like '1/2'; float entries are refused, never rounded. The convention: sum_r u[r][a*m+b] * v[r][c*p+d] * w[r][e*p+f] equals 1 iff (b==c and e==a and f==d), else 0. This grader is deterministic, cannot be argued with, and its feedback is its own arithmetic — use the REFUTED mechanism to repair the decomposition and resubmit.
